sottos-payload.note: Private Sottos Payload CMS MCP server. Requires Clerk OAuth through the MCP client login flow; API keys are not supported. OAuth opens https://sottos-web.vercel.app/admin when an admin session exists, otherwise https://sottos-web.vercel.app/sign-in. Expected tools: posts/tags/categories/media find/update/create where safe, getBlogDraftContext for compact inventory and cover references, getMediaReferences for cover-image references, plus uploadMedia for normalized base64 image uploads. OAuth supports refresh_token so clients can renew without repeated browser login. For cover images, upload the original generated image at 1400x875 pixels or larger; low-resolution, downscaled, or recompressed derivatives are rejected. Create post drafts with top-level draft:true and _status:"draft". Users tools must not be exposed. Delete tools should normally stay disabled; if enabled later, clients must confirm before use and prefer draft/unpublish rollback paths.
